title: Pillow
body:
Description

"Impresive that you found me, but can you please put me back? I do not want to be purchased."


The pillow can be found at the Radical Shack and Dugg's Digging and can be bought for $4,799. It has no real uses, though some say it can be used to transport a certain Ogre's glass duck...

Another pillow can be found at Mike's Mines but cannot be picked up nor interacted with.

Can be used to transport the glass duck.

Trivia

The item was originally priced at $2,000
